name: WSI-Bench
description: WSI-Bench is a benchmark for whole-slide image (WSI) analysis in digital pathology that evaluates model performance on slide-level tasks such as classification, segmentation, and detection using tiled WSI inputs. It measures robustness to common WSI challenges (e.g., stain variation, large image size) and assesses generalization across slides and centers. The benchmark supports development of clinical and research-grade WSI algorithms by providing standardized tasks and evaluation protocols.
general_score_metric: AUC (task-dependent; e.g., Dice for segmentation, mAP for detection)
reputation: Niche but relevant within the digital pathology / medical imaging research community.
